faq.q: When is the F1 Grand Prix 2035 in Marbella?
faq.a: The exact dates for the 2035 F1 Grand Prix in Marbella have not been announced yet. Historically, the race is held in late May or early June. We recommend booking your yacht charter as soon as dates are confirmed – availability goes fast.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the F1 Grand Prix 2035?
faq.a: We offer 16 boats in our fleet, from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 (5 pax) up to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax). Popular choices for the Grand Prix include the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h), the Azimut 39 (€749/2h), and the Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h with free jet ski). All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How much does a yacht charter cost for the F1 Grand Prix 2035?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, Mangusta 80 Grey) cost from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and include a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. Prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and 21% VAT.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). There are no hidden fees – just show up and enjoy.

faq.q: Can I watch the F1 race from the yacht?
faq.a: Yes, you can anchor near the coastline or in Puerto Banús itself to watch the race on a large screen or listen to the commentary. Some yachts are equipped with TVs. Alternatively, you can combine a cruise along the Marbella coastline with attending the official race events.

faq.q: Where do the yachts depart from?
faq.a: All our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella – the heart of the Golden Mile and just a few minutes from the F1 paddock. You can also arrange pick-up from Marbella Marina, Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande on request.

faq.q: How many people can I bring on the yacht?
faq.a: Capacity ranges from 5 passengers (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) up to 12 passengers on most larger boats (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Ferretti 94, Canados 86). The Astondoa 40 holds 9 pax, and the Azimut 39 holds 11 pax. Check individual boat pages for exact limits.

faq.q: Do I need to book in advance for the F1 Grand Prix 2035?
faq.a: Absolutely. The F1 Grand Prix is one of the busiest weekends in Marbella. Yacht charters sell out weeks in advance. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months ahead. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on specific boats.

data.body_html:
The F1 Grand Prix 2035 in Marbella promises to be the most glamorous race weekend on the calendar. With the Mediterranean as your backdrop and Puerto Banús as your base, there is no better way to experience the speed, luxury and excitement than aboard a private yacht charter. Whether you want to watch the race from the sea, host a party before the podium, or simply escape the crowds in style, our fleet of 16 boats – from the compact Mariah SX21 to the 29m Ferretti 94 – offers something for every group. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and 21% VAT, so you can focus on the action.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for the F1 Grand Prix 2035 in Marbella?

Marbella’s F1 weekend is more than a race – it’s a full-blown social event. The paddock in Puerto Banús buzzes with celebrities, drivers and influencers. A private yacht gives you a front-row seat to the spectacle while offering total privacy. You can anchor near the marina to watch the race on a screen, cruise along the Golden Mile, or head to Cala del Faro for a swim between sessions. With our boats departing from Puerto Banús, you are never more than 5 minutes from the action.

Our Fleet for the F1 Grand Prix 2035

We operate 16 motor yachts and speedboats, all based in Puerto Banús. Here is a quick overview of the most popular choices for race weekend:

For smaller groups (up to 5 pax), the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are perfect for a quick spin. For larger parties, the Maiora 26m or K80 (24m) offer serious deck space. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and VAT. Browse our full fleet here.

What’s Included in Your F1 Grand Prix Charter?

Every charter comes with a licensed skipper who knows the local waters, fuel for the entire trip, a selection of soft drinks, water, beer, white wine and cava, plus light snacks. Insurance and safety equipment are included, as is Spanish IVA (21% VAT). There are no extra charges – just show up at Puerto Banús and step aboard.

Best Itineraries for F1 Grand Prix Weekend

Here are three popular routes to combine race viewing with the best of the Costa del Sol:

  • Puerto Banús to Marbella Marina – Cruise along the Golden Mile, watch the race from the water, then dock at Marbella Marina for dinner.
  • Puerto Banús to Cala Cortés – Anchor in this secluded cove for a swim, then return to the marina for the evening events.
  • Puerto Banús to Estepona – A longer cruise (approx. 15 NM) past Cabopino and the dunes, perfect for a full-day charter.

All routes depart from Puerto Banús. For a shorter trip, stay close to the marina and enjoy the F1 atmosphere from your yacht.

Book Your F1 Grand Prix 2035 Yacht Charter

Demand for yacht charters during the F1 Grand Prix is extremely high. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, Mangusta 80 Grey) are available from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and include a free jet ski. For all other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Contact us today to reserve your spot.
